package serveapp

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/apiv1"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/runforkexecution"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/store/storetest"
)

// Discriminating probe: the ordinary HTTP deadline and full journey
// remain unchanged. Observe actual writer ownership while the request is live.
func TestChannelSourceForkDeadlineDiagnosticProbe(t *testing.T) {
	priorProjection := projectRuntimePersistenceForServe
	projectRuntimePersistenceForServe = func(owner *selectedStoreOwner) serveRuntimePersistence {
		out := priorProjection(owner)
		collector := storetest.CollectTransactions(t, out.deps.EventStore, storetest.TransactionProbeOptions{})
		priorCaps := buildSelectedAPICapabilities
		buildSelectedAPICapabilities = func(selected *selectedStoreOwner, req selectedAPICapabilityRequest) (selectedAPICapabilities, error) {
			caps, err := priorCaps(selected, req)
			if err != nil {
				return caps, err
			}
			if executor, ok := caps.RunFork.(apiv1.SelectedContractRunForkExecutor); ok {
				original := executor.ExecuteSelectedContractRunFork
				executor.ExecuteSelectedContractRunFork = func(ctx context.Context, req runforkexecution.SelectedContractExecutionRequest) (runforkexecution.SelectedContractExecutionResult, error) {
					start := time.Now()
					t.Logf("FORK_PROBE begin transaction snapshot: %+v", collector.Snapshot())
					done, joined := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
					go func() {
						defer close(joined)
						timer := time.NewTimer(3 * time.Second)
						defer timer.Stop()
						select {
						case <-done:
							return
						case <-timer.C:
						}
						t.Logf("FORK_PROBE 3s transaction snapshot: %+v", collector.Snapshot())
						path := fmt.Sprintf("/home/youmew/.cache/swarm-2542-family145/fork-live-%d.stacks", start.UnixNano())
						if file, err := os.Create(path); err == nil {
							_ = pprof.Lookup("goroutine").WriteTo(file, 2)
							_ = file.Close()
						}
					}()
					defer func() {
						close(done)
						<-joined
						t.Logf("FORK_PROBE end elapsed=%s transaction snapshot: %+v", time.Since(start), collector.Snapshot())
					}()
					return original(ctx, req)
				}
				caps.RunFork = executor
			}
			return caps, nil
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() { buildSelectedAPICapabilities = priorCaps })
		return out
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { projectRuntimePersistenceForServe = priorProjection })
	TestChannelSourceLifecyclePublicJourney(t)
}
